title: Loan Refinancing Calculator
description: An app to calculate if refinancing a loan is worth it based on current and new loan details
initialPrompt:
Let's create a helper to calculate if worth refinancing a loan. E.g. Car loan, house etc.

Items to ensure we have as input:
Current loan details - 
Total purchase amount
current interest rate
term - months
Any final balloon payment
current total owing.

Inputs of other loan details to compare with:
New term
New interest rate
any balloon payments

Outputs we would want to see:
monthly payments
total paid
total interest paid

textInput.title: Current Loan details
textInput.placeholder: enter all details about your loan, amount, start date, interest, length, balloon payment, current position
textInput.defaultValue:
Loan Amount: $350,000.00
Loan Date: 5/15/20
Interest Charge: $120,000.00
Term of Loan: 360 months (30 years)
Monthly Payments: 359 payments of $1,750.00 at 4.500%.
1 Final Payment: $15,000.00 at 4.500%.
Current Position:
Gross Balance as of 10/30/24: $325,000.00
Add Interest on Overdue Balance (ODI): $0.00
Less Rebate of Future Finance Charge: $25,000.00 CR

textInput.title: New Interest Rate
textInput.placeholder: Enter the interest rate for the potential new loan (e.g. 4.25%)

textInput.title: New Balloon Payment
textInput.placeholder: Enter any final balloon payment amount for the potential new loan

textInput.title: New Loan Term (months)
textInput.placeholder: Enter the term in months for the potential new loan

qQuery.prompt:
Objective:
Determine if refinancing the current loan to a new loan would result in savings by comparing total payments, interest, and monthly payment amounts.

Input Fields:
Given the current loan details: @26e77c94-70b9-457d-bfc3-b7aa706a322b

Loan Amount (Original),
Interest Rate,
Total Term (months),
Balloon Payment (if applicable),
Total Interest (if known),
Remaining Balance,
Months Remaining.

and
Potential New Loan (Refinance) Options:
New Term (months): @5790865c-1646-4c46-aaa4-41717d310360
New Interest Rate: @0f1ae5b9-3cee-4910-86af-e7cb97cffc4d
New Balloon Payment (if applicable): @00a18fd8-6b91-41f2-813f-31a1b9950b9f

Calculation Steps and Outputs:

Monthly Payment Calculation:

Current Loan:
Calculate the remaining monthly payment based on the remaining balance and months left, considering the balloon payment at the end of the term.

New Refinance Loan:
Calculate the monthly payment using the loan amortization formula for the new terms (new term, interest rate, and balloon payment if applicable).

Total Amount Paid (Principal + Interest):

Current Loan:
Calculate the total of remaining payments plus the balloon payment.

New Loan(s):
Calculate the total paid for each refinance option, including balloon payment if applicable.

Total Interest Paid:
Calculate the total interest paid for both the current and new loan options.

Comparison Outputs:
Present results in a clear table format showing at least three columns for:
Current Loan Paid So Far
Current Loan Continued
New Comparison Loan

Ensure the current loan paid so far loan term is the number of months elapsed, adversely the current loan continued term would be months left if continued to compare.

Final Recommendation:
Based on the calculations, provide a recommendation on whether refinancing to the new loan terms would be financially beneficial or not, taking into account the monthly payments, total interest, and total amounts paid.
qQuery.title: Loan Refinancing Analysis
